title: Garden and Kitchen
author: Tamsin Pemberton
blurb: Sebastian Yarrow, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, has spent twenty years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
